limn.options.title: Limn
limn.options.enabled.tooltip: Recolor the box drawn around the block you are looking at.
limn.options.alpha.tooltip: Transparency of the outline. 255 is fully opaque. Every style uses it.
limn.options.color.tooltip: Outline color. Rainbow ignores it, Chase lights it up, and Mining Progress fades it to red as the block breaks.
limn.options.width.tooltip: Thickness compared with Minecraft's own outline. 1.0 is vanilla.
limn.options.width.unsupported: Not available before Minecraft 1.21.11 - the game doesn't support variable outline thickness on older versions.
limn.options.rainbow_speed.tooltip: How fast Rainbow and Chase move. 1.0 is one full cycle every four seconds.
limn.options.rainbow_spread.tooltip: How much Rainbow and Chase change across one block. 0 makes the whole outline change together.
